titles.title: Flowering Cactus

description: This artwork is on the back of *Maple Leaves*, 1925 (cat. no. 500). In this semiabstract work, a bright red cactus flower springs from a red and purple plant. These forms contrast with a vibrant green and yellow shape in the background of the work.
title: Flowering Cactus
